buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses FACILITIES MANAGEMENT SERVICES INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS/HOW TO QUOTE -- ONLINE ONLY: i. The bidder shall strictly quote as per instructions in the MANDATORY FINANCIAL UPLOAD DOCUMENT. T he link for this document is available in Page no. 4 of the bid document under EXCEL UPLOAD REQUIRED. The bidder shall download this document and follow the instructions by filling ONLY the specified cells an d entering values as indicated in the GeM bid submission on the priced bid portal and If Bidders not uploa ding excel file as indicated in GEM Bid Document than Bidder offer shall be rejected without giving any in formation and bidders are not supposed to attach any price bid details in the technical offer. ii. Quantity for each line item is mentioned in excel file is available in Page no.4 of the bid document und er EXCEL UPLOAD REQUIRED and bidder to Quote for total quantity of each line from G7 to G21 as per ex cel file and same amount to be mention in gem portal online.

iii. Schedule wise total value as indicated in Column G of the excel sheet shall be entered against schedu le wise rate in GeM tender. iv. For Schedule No 1, 2 and 14 bidder should not quote less than Minimum prices indicated in the bid doc ument. v. HPCL shall NOT be bound/ obligated to procure any minimum quantity of any Item nor any minimum v alue of material/ services/works and HPCL does not assure nor guarantee availing / consumption of full q uantity, from the Vendor. vi. Bidder is also requested to furnish copies of all documents as required in this tender along with the U npriced Bid. vii. Do not upload the Price details in the technical bid. Offers from vendors uploading the Price details or any other document indicating prices along with technical bid shall be rejected without any further corres pondence. SCOPE OF JOB Scope of works include providing & managing daily services for activities pertaining to housekeeping, clea ning, upkeep of buildings & facilities including interiors, facade, terrace, surround and also for roads, path ways & gardens, hostel facilities, other area of the campus by seamless co-ordination of daily activities an d services Brief scope of works indicative but not limited to is as follows: 1. Cleaning & Janitor services for buildings & facilities (except internal housekeeping of Utility rooms includin g Sub-Stations, AHU Rooms, Chiller Plant rooms, Warehouse, Solvent Store, Gas-Store, Electrical Rooms, U PS & Battery Rooms) 2. Pest, Rodent & reptile Control Services 3. Maintenance and upkeep of landscaped areas & indoor plants 4. Cleaning and upkeep of Roads, pathways & building precinct 5. Trash removal and waste management (within the premises) 6. Housekeeping of Hostel/ Gurukul facilities (external areas only & excluding rooms) 7. Office service management services like Front Desk, Pantry etc. For detailed scope of job refer attachment in this tender CONTRACT PERIOD Contract shall be valid for a period 02 Years from the date i.e., 03-Dec-2026. The rates shall be firm until completion of the order. JOB COMMENCEMENT & MOBILIZATION:

Within 15 days from the date of PO. Agency shall complete total deployment of manpower and machinery within 15 days from the date of PO. Any shortfall after 15 days shall attract penalty as per PO terms and co nditions. PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. (Attached in ‘Buyer added Bid S pecific ATC) PENALTY In the event of any violations relating to Safety, Health & Environment, the following penalties shall be appl icable: a) First Deviation: A penalty of Rs. 1,000/- shall be imposed. b) Second Deviation: A warning letter shall be issued by the Engineer-in-Charge (EIC) along with a penalty of Rs. 5,000/-. c) Third Deviation: A warning letter shall be issued by the Head of Department (HoD) along with a penalty of Rs. 50,000/-. PAYMENT TERMS Payment to be released as follows: i. 100% Payment will be made for each RA Bill after job completion and approved with all relevant documen ts/certificates. Note for Payment: 1. Agency shall ensure submission of complete documentation as required along with the bill for further proce ssing including the following: a) Statutory compliances documentation (ESI, PF, Wages, Bonus Etc complete) b) Payment for all the contract workmen shall be ensured by 7th of each Month. c) Gate passes for consumables. Material reconciliation documents as applicable. d) Signed checklists and feedback forms for service certification. e) Attendance records with biometric data. f) Consumption details of chemicals/consumables. g) All equipment working condition report along the deployment details. h) Any other additional documentation as required. 2. In the event of non-compliance/non-performance/non availability of tools & tackles/non availability of equi pment/ non-supply of consumables etc. Deductions shall be made in Agency Bill as per Annexure-VIII - Pen alty Sheet. 3. The final bill shall be submitted by the Contractor within the time frame of sixty (60) days from the date o f completion of the work. No further claims shall be made by the Contractor after submission of the final bil l. The Contractor shall submit the final bill complete in all respect with no claim and no dues by Contractor , and other completion documents as applicable, including material consumption/ reconciliation statement.

4. Given the fact that the contactor is under legal obligation to pay due wages as the requirements of law, t he successful bidder shall be expected to make payment to the workmen under Electronic Fund Transfer S ystem. The contractor shall pay for all legal charges/contributions to statutory authorities. Besides that, th e contractor shall be obliged to satisfy empowered officer about continued labour law compliance as and when required by empowered officer. 5. Agency to note that while considering the attendance and availability of the staff, their working hours may also be considered for evaluation and non – compliance with the mentioned hours of work would be penaliz ed. Penalty would be in terms of part of the salary / payment, which would be deducted. 6. If deployment of manpower to provide services under any item of the BOQ/ SOR in any month is not as pe r minimum deployment of Contract, proportionate deduction shall be made as per minimum wage per man power considering weight of all skills for that item. E.g. In case 2 Nos. manpower are not deployed for 26 Days for unskilled manpower, 2X26X(Minimum wage for unskilled manpower) shall be deducted from the Bill TRAVEL ALLOWANCE Travel Allowance shall be payable extra at actual against submission of documentary proof. A separate line item shall be incorporation in HPCL’s SAP PO for Payment agai nst Travel Allowance. Maximum Basis Financial Limit for the same is ₹ 48,00,000/- (Rupees Forty Eight Lakh s Only) for Two Years. CPBG / RETENTION Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. (Attached in ‘Buyer added Bid S pecific ATC) Quantum: 5% of total contract value shall be applicable. SECURITY DEPOSIT Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. Quantum: 2% of total contract value shall be applicable. DISPUTE RESOLUTION CLAUSE FOR CONTRACTS WITH INDIAN & FOREIGN P ARTIES: Dispute resolution clause as per attachment attached in ATC For instances where the bidder is a public sector company (CPSE) or a Government d epartment the AMRCD mechanism as per below clause shall. Public Sector v/s. Government Department or vice versa:

In all existing and future contracts/agreements with other CPSEs’, Central Government/Departments and S tate Governments/Departments/Organizations except agreements with Railways, Income Tax, Customs an d Excise Departments the following Administrative Mechanism for Resolution of CPSE Disputes” (AMRCD) c lause will be incorporated: “ln the event of any dispute or difference relating to the interpretation and appl ication of the provisions of the commercial contract(s) between Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs)/ Port Trusts inter se and also between CPSEs and Government Departments/Organizations (excluding dispu tes relating to Railways, Income Tax, Customs & Excise Departments), such dispute or difference shall be t aken up by either party for its resolution through AMRCD as mentioned in DPE OM No. 05/0003/2019-FTS-1 0937 dated 14th December, 2022 and the decision of AMRCD on the said dispute will be binding on both th e parties.” DECLARATION FORMS Bidder must submit following four declaration forms as per format attached in the ATC a. Declaration on not Banned or Blacklisted b. Declaration on Acceptance to HPCL Tender Terms & Conditions c. Integrity pact d. PPLC – Local Content Declaration OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS AND IMPORTANT INFORMAITON. Unless otherwise specified, in case of conflict, HPCL’s General Terms and Condition (HPCL GTC) shall take precedence over GEM’s General Terms and Conditions (GeM GTC) For all other Terms & Conditions, Scope, Bidders’ Pre-Qualification Criteria etc. refer, ‘ Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC’ . 5. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
